WITH d1 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999
),
d2 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
),
d3 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999
),
joined AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
         i.i_item_desc AS i_item_desc,
         s.s_store_id AS s_store_id,
         s.s_store_name AS s_store_name,
         ss.ss_net_profit,
         sr.sr_net_loss,
         cs.cs_net_profit
  FROM d1
  JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
  JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
                       AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
                       AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  JOIN d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  JOIN catalog_sales cs ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
                       AND sr.sr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  JOIN d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       i_item_desc,
       s_store_id,
       s_store_name,
       max(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       max(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       max(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM joined
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
